item.title: Shooting, Industrial Accident, Grand Lucayan Dispute
item.ns0:title: Shooting, Industrial Accident, Grand Lucayan Dispute
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, police confirm a second death following a Thursday shooting on John Road after a 22-year-old victim succumbs to his injuries, while authorities on Spanish Wells launch an investigation into a tragic workplace fatality. Opposition Leader Michael Pintard clashes with the Prime Minister over unpaid Grand Lucayan severance payments and raises critical concerns regarding Grand Bahama healthcare services. Meanwhile, environmental partners in Grand Bahama push for urgent action against illegal dumping as a key cleanliness campaign marks two decades of impact. Tune in for all these stories, a special look at local entrepreneurship, and your complete weekend sports and weather update.
